sentences.en: In Algeria, many businesses are on the brink of bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 在阿尔及利亚，许多企业濒临破产。

sentences.en: Yanni is so broke he's on the verge of bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 扬尼手头这么紧，都快破产了。

sentences.en: Corporate bankruptcies continued at a high level last month.
sentences.zh: 上个月企业破产数量依然居高不下。

senses.zh: 破产；倒闭 - 彻底失败;(名誉等的)完全丧失

mnemonic: 词根记忆：bankrupt（破产的）+cy（表状态）→破产
